explanation: In 1969 the company's founder, Enric Bernat, asked Dalí for a new design. He sketched a daisy-shaped logo and suggested placing it on top of the wrapper, where it could be seen whole.

claims.text: In 1969 Salvador Dalí designed the logo of the lollipop brand Chupa Chups.
Enric Bernat, the founder of Chupa Chups, asked Dalí to design the logo.
Dalí's Chupa Chups logo is shaped like a daisy, and he suggested placing it on top of the wrapper so it would be visible whole.
